DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人は二キロぐらいなら歩けると言っています。この道が二キロなら往復してよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人二キロ希望に片道二キロ経路の往復を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend says they can walk about two kilometers. I thought we could go there and back if this route is two kilometers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about making a round trip on a route that is two kilometers one way when your friend wants to walk two kilometers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の距離は片道です。同じ道を戻る予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The distance on the map is one way. Are you planning to return along the same route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。往復全部で二キロと思っていたので、友人にはそう伝えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復合計二キロと誤読し友人へ誤伝達済みと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought the whole round trip was two kilometers, and I already told my friend that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you misread the total round-trip distance as two kilometers and have already given your friend the wrong information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 距離の数え方を伝え直してください。短い経路を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please correct how you explained the distance. We can check a shorter route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ片道二キロだったと訂正し、短い別の道を一緒に選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 片道二キロへ訂正して短い別道を共同選択すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my friend it was two kilometers one way and choose a different, shorter route together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will correct the distance to two kilometers one way and choose another shorter route together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ入口へ戻るかも確認しましょう。休憩場所の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's also check whether you will return to the same entrance. Do you have any preferences for places to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で座れる所がある方がよいです。二キロ歩けるから休憩不要とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中座れる休憩希望で距離許容を休憩不要としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: A route with somewhere to sit along the way would be better. I don't assume that being able to walk two kilometers means no rest is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want somewhere to sit and rest along the way and that being able to cover the distance does not mean no rest is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図の距離と休憩場所を合わせて見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can look at both the distances and the rest spots on the guide map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 片道と往復を分け、友人へ距離を訂正してから短い休憩付き経路を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片道往復区別訂正後に短い休憩付経路相談を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish one-way and round-trip distances, correct the distance I told my friend, then discuss a shorter route with rest stops.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will distinguish one-way and round-trip distances, correct the information, then discuss a shorter route with rest stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの経路を一緒に確認しましょう。無理のない範囲でお歩きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let's check this route together. Please walk only as far as is comfortable for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 券売機に行き先と人数がもう出ています。私が選んだものではないので、進めてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 券売機の本人未選択駅人数画面を進めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The ticket machine already shows a destination and number of passengers. I didn't select them, so I don't know whether I should proceed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may proceed on a ticket-machine screen showing a station and passenger count you did not select. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお金やカードは入れていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't inserted any money or a card yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何も入れていません。前の方が離れた後に来たら、この画面でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前客離席後の残存画面で金銭カード未投入と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't inserted anything. This screen was showing when I came over after the previous person left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the previous customer's screen remained after they left and that you have not inserted money or a card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前の方の操作が残っている可能性があります。引き継がず係員が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The previous person's selections may still be there. A staff member will check without continuing their transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の行き先とは違う駅なので、自分の購入として確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人行先不一致で残存選択を購入確定しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a different station from my destination, so I won't confirm those selections as my own purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the destination does not match yours and you will not confirm the remaining selections as a purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。前の方のお金や切符が残っているかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We'll also check whether the previous person's money or tickets are still there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残っていても自分の物として取りません。この機械の確認が終わるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残存金銭券を本人所有とせず係員確認を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if anything is left, I won't take it as mine. I'll wait until this machine has been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not treat any remaining money or tickets as your own and will wait for staff to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の機械をご案内できるかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll also check whether we can direct you to another machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残った選択や物を使わず、自分の購入を最初からできる機械へ案内してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他客選択残置物を使わず本人初期購入機へ案内希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please direct me to a machine where I can start my own purchase from the beginning, without using the selections or items left behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to be directed to a machine where you can start your own purchase, without using another customer's selections or belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらを確認しますので、隣の係員とお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll check this machine, so please wait with the staff member next to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知の裏が白紙だと思って買物メモを書きました。下に手続きの説明があったので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知裏買物メモが説明文に重なったため相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the back of the notice was blank and wrote a shopping list there. Then I noticed instructions for the procedure underneath, so I'd like some help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because the shopping notes you wrote on the back of a notice overlap its instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書き込んだ部分と元の印刷を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you show me the part you wrote on and the original printing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青いペンの文字は私のメモです。印刷の一部に重なっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人青ペンと原印刷を区別して示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The blue pen writing is my notes. It overlaps part of the printing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the difference between your blue pen writing and the original printing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人の書込みを通知の条件と混ぜずに確認しましょう。元の文が読めない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check without confusing your writing with the notice's conditions. Is any of the original text unreadable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 締切の説明の一行が読みづらいです。私のメモから日付を推測しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 締切一行不可読で本人メモから日付推測しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: One line explaining the deadline is hard to read. I won't guess the date from my notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that one line about the deadline is unreadable and you will not infer the date from your own notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ正しい案内の確認を依頼します。通知は切り取らずお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the person in charge to confirm the correct instructions. Please keep the notice without cutting any part off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このまま渡します。自分の書込みを消して元の状態だったと説明することもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知未切取で保持し本人書込を消して元状態としないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll hand it over as it is. I also won't erase my writing and claim it was in its original condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the notice uncut and will not erase your writing and present it as the original condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。必要に応じて読める案内をご用意できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If necessary, I'll check whether we can provide a legible copy of the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の青字と元の印刷を分けて示し、読めない締切説明を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青字と原文区別提示し締切説明を担当照会すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll separately point out my blue writing and the original printing, and ask the person in charge to confirm the unreadable deadline instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will distinguish your blue writing from the original text and ask the person in charge about the deadline instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知担当へご案内します。お知らせありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll direct you to the person responsible for notices. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察が終わりました。仕事へ戻る予定ですが、会計までまだ待ちますか。外へ出る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察後に仕事へ戻る予定なので外出前に会計待ちの状況を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My consultation is over. I'm planning to return to work, but do I still need to wait for payment? I'd like to check before going outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to return to work after your consultation and ask about the payment wait before going outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会計の番号札はお持ちですか。あとどのくらいで仕事へ戻る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your payment queue ticket? How soon do you need to be back at work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 札は持っています。三十分後には戻ると会社へ伝えましたが、まだ呼ばれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号札を持ち会社には三十分後帰着と伝えたがまだ呼ばれていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my ticket. I told my company I'd be back in thirty minutes, but my number hasn't been called yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have your queue ticket and told your company you would return in thirty minutes, but have not been called yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待ち状況を確認します。戻れる時刻を今ここでお約束はできません。お支払いは済んでいませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the queue. I can't promise right now what time you will be able to return. You haven't paid yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。会計を済ませたつもりで帰らず、会社へ到着が遅れる可能性を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支払い未完了なので帰らず勤務先へ遅延の可能性を連絡すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. I won't leave as though I had already paid. I'll tell my company I may arrive late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that because payment is not complete, you will not leave and will tell your workplace you may be delayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話する間に番号が呼ばれた場合の扱いも確認できます。電話はどちらでなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can also check what happens if your number is called while you are on the phone. Where will you make your call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話を使える場所で短く連絡したいです。札を持って勝手に外へ出る前に、離席を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話可能な場所で短く連絡するため離席前に窓口へ申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to make a short call somewhere phones are allowed. Before going outside on my own with the ticket, I'll tell the desk that I'm stepping away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the desk before stepping away to make a short call in a place where phone calls are allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内した場所でお願いします。お戻りになったら、番号の状況を窓口でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the place we show you. When you return, check the status of your number at the desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 短く会社へ連絡して戻り、番号を確認して会計を待ちます。出発時刻は支払いを終えてから知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡後に番号を確認して会計を待ち支払い後に出発時刻を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll briefly call my company, come back, check my number, and wait to pay. I'll tell them my departure time after I have paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after the call you will check your number and wait to pay, then give your departure time after paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。会計担当にもお伝えします。お戻りになったらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll also let the payment staff know. Please speak to us when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯を拾いました。画面に十時と見えましたが、それを拾った時刻として書いてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得携帯画面十時を本人発見時刻記入可否として尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a mobile phone. I saw ten o'clock on its screen, but I'm not sure whether I can write that as the time I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can enter the ten o'clock shown on the found phone's screen as the time you found it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾った時、ご自身で時計を確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you check a clock yourself when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: していません。携帯の画面が点いて十時と見えただけです。画像の時計かどうかも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人時計未確認で画面表示画像かも不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The phone's screen lit up and I just saw ten o'clock. I don't even know whether it was a clock in an image.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not check a clock yourself and do not know whether the screen display was an image. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 端末に見えた表示と、実際の拾得時刻を分けましょう。前後の行動は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's distinguish the display you saw on the device from the actual time you found it. Do you remember what you were doing before and after?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝の買物から帰る途中でした。店のレシート時刻は九時四十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 買物帰途と会計九時四十分レシートを手掛かりとして示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was on my way home from shopping that morning. The time on the store receipt is 9:40.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your journey home from shopping and the receipt showing a 9:40 checkout as clues. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それは会計した時刻ですね。拾った瞬間の時刻とは別に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's the time you paid, then. We'll ask about that separately from the moment you found the phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。正確な拾得時刻は分からないと伝え、行動の手掛かりとしてレシートを示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートは会計時刻で正確拾得時刻不明と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll say that I don't know the exact time I found it, and show the receipt as a clue to what I was doing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the receipt's checkout time from the unknown exact time you found the phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾った場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell me where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 公園入口のベンチ下です。画面表示の十時を確定時刻にせず、場所と帰り道の経緯を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口ベンチ下と帰途経緯を報告し画面十時を確定しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Under the bench at the park entrance. I won't treat ten o'clock on the screen as a confirmed time; I'll explain the location and what happened on my way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the spot under the entrance bench and the circumstances on your way home, and say you will not treat ten o'clock on the screen as confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ引き継ぎます。届けてくださりありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll pass this to the person in charge. Thank you for bringing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 発送の伝票を書きましたが、下の紙には住所がほとんど写っていません。これで受付できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送伝票の下の紙に住所が写らないため受付できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've filled in the shipping form, but almost none of the address copied onto the sheet underneath. Can you accept it like this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your shipment can be accepted when the address did not copy onto the lower sheet of the shipping form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 伝票を重ねたまま書きましたか。途中で紙を外しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you write with the sheets stacked together? Did you remove a sheet at any point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書きやすいように上の一枚だけ外しました。残りの紙は机に置いたままでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上の紙だけを外して書き残りを机へ置いたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I removed only the top sheet to make it easier to write. I left the other sheets on the desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you took off only the top sheet to write on and left the rest on the desk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 複写の部分を確認します。宛先の控えも読めるようにするため、新しい伝票で書き直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the carbon-copy sections. Let's fill out a new form so the destination copy is legible too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい一組をください。今度は重ねたまま書きます。古い伝票はどうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重ねて書く新伝票を依頼し古い伝票の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please give me a new set. This time I'll write with the sheets stacked together. What should I do with the old form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a new form to fill in with the sheets stacked and ask what to do with the old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ荷物には貼らず、こちらへ見せてください。新しい伝票へ写す住所は別のメモでも確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't attach it to the parcel yet; please show it to me. Can you also check the address for the new form against a separate note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受取人から届いた住所があります。上の紙だけを頼りにせず、そのメッセージと合わせて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取人の住所メッセージを示し書き写す宛先を照合すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the address the recipient sent me. I'll write it while checking that message as well, rather than relying only on the top sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the recipient's address message and say you will cross-check the destination you copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入後に下の紙も確認します。お客様の控えを外すタイミングはこちらでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the lower sheets after you've filled it in too. We'll tell you when to detach your copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一組のまま書き直し、住所のメッセージと下の紙を照合します。控えを外す前に窓口へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一組のまま書き直し下の紙も確認して控えを外す前に窓口へ渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll fill it out again with the whole set together and compare the address message with the lower sheets. I'll hand it to the desk before removing my copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will fill it out as one set, also check the lower sheets, and hand it to the desk before detaching your copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの新しい伝票をお使いください。記入できましたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please use this new form. Let us know when you have filled it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外の学校へ出す残高証明書を英語で作りたいです。名前の書き方も相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校提出用の英文残高証明書と氏名表記を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a balance certificate in English to submit to a school overseas. Can I also ask about how my name should be written?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an English balance certificate for a school and how to write your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行できる書式を担当が確認します。提出先に氏名表記の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge will check which formats we can issue. Does the receiving institution specify how to write your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学校から、申込みに使った氏名と同じ表記にするよう言われました。パスポートの写しも持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学校の氏名一致指定とパスポート写しを持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The school told me to use exactly the same name as on my application. I also have a copy of my passport.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the school requires matching name details and that you brought a passport copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の口座と提出先の指定を確認します。申込書のお名前はもう書かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check your own account and the receiving institution's requirements. Have you already written your name on the request form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。例では名字が後ろなので、学校へ出した順序も変えるのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未記入で例の姓名順序に合わせ学校提出名も変えるのか迷ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. The example puts the family name last, so I'm unsure whether I should also change the order I used for the school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not filled it in and are unsure whether to change the name order submitted to the school to match the example. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 例の名前をそのまま写さず、ご自身の資料を担当へ示してください。使える表記をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't copy the example name as it is; show your own documents to the person in charge. They'll explain the name formats you can use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 学校へ出した申込書の控えも見せます。省略せず、この綴りと順序で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 学校申込控えを示し省略しない綴りと順序で相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll also show my copy of the school application. I'd like to ask about using this spelling and order without abbreviating anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your copy of the school application and ask to discuss the full spelling and name order without abbreviations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。発行までの期間と受取方法も確認しましょう。提出の期限はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Let's also check how long issuance takes and how you can receive it. When is the submission deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来週金曜です。氏名の表記と発行予定を確認してから申し込み、期限に間に合う受取方法を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 来週金曜の期限を示し表記と発行予定を確かめ受取方法を選びたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next Friday. I'd like to confirm the name format and expected issue date before applying, and choose a way to receive it in time for the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give next Friday as the deadline and say you want to check the name format and expected issue date, then choose a collection method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。学校の指定と氏名の資料をお手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you with the person in charge. Please keep the school's requirements and your name documents handy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい袋を値札の商品と思ってかごに入れました。試供品と書いてあるので、買う物か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カゴ内小袋の試供品表示に気づき販売品かを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put a small bag in my basket thinking it was the product on the price tag. It says 'sample,' so I'd like to check whether it's for sale.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you noticed the sample label on the small bag in your basket and ask whether it is for sale. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 販売用の商品は別の大きい袋です。その小袋は配布条件を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The product for sale is a separate, larger bag. The person in charge will check the distribution conditions for that small bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 値札の容量は二百グラムでした。この小袋には二十グラムとあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 値札二百グラムと小袋二十グラム差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The quantity on the price tag was two hundred grams. This small bag says twenty grams.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between two hundred grams on the price tag and twenty grams on the small bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容量も違いますね。勝手に同じ商品として会計しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The quantities are different too. Please don't just check it out as the same product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小袋を一袋買えばよいと思いましたが、販売用ではないと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小袋一袋購入と思ったが販売対象別と理解したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought I could buy one small bag, but now I understand that it isn't the item for sale.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you thought you could buy one small bag but now understand the item for sale is different. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 何を購入したいかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also tell me what you'd like to buy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 料理に使う分を買いたいので、大きい販売用の袋を選びます。小袋は店員さんへ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理用販売大袋を選び試供小袋を店員へ渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to buy some for cooking, so I'll choose the large bag for sale. I'll give the small bag to a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose the large retail bag for cooking and hand the small sample bag to a staff member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 試供品が必要な場合は配布の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you want a sample, please check the distribution information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二百グラムの販売用を購入し、二十グラムの試供品は条件を確認せず持ち帰りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 販売二百グラム購入と条件未確認試供二十グラム未持帰りを復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll buy the two-hundred-gram retail bag, and I won't take the twenty-gram sample home without checking the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will buy the two-hundred-gram retail product and will not take the twenty-gram sample without checking the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。小袋をお預かりします。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll take the small bag. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ボール遊びの目印に木へテープを貼りました。終わったので外したいですが、少し残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遊び目印テープを木へ貼り終了後残存処理を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I stuck tape on trees as markers for a ball game. We've finished, so I want to remove it, but some is still there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to deal with tape left on trees after using it as markers for a game that has now finished. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの木に、どんなテープを貼りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which trees did you put it on, and what kind of tape was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 広場の端の二本です。白いテープで、片方は剥がしましたが糊が残って見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二本白テープで一本剥離後糊残存と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two trees at the edge of the square. It was white tape. I peeled it off one tree, but it looks as though glue remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you put white tape on two trees and glue remains on one after peeling it off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理に木の表面を削らず、担当へ場所を知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the person in charge where it is, without forcibly scraping the tree's surface.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残りをナイフで削ろうとはせず、貼った場所と外した所を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 刃物削りを試さず貼付剥離地点を示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't try scraping the remainder off with a knife. I'll show where I put the tape and where I removed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not try scraping with a blade and will show where the tape was attached and removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が状態を確認します。ほかにも目印は付けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the condition. Did you put up any other markers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 木は二本だけです。地面の道具は片付けましたが、もう一本のテープはそのままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 木二本のみ地上道具片付済み他一本テープ未剥離と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only on those two trees. I've put away the equipment on the ground, but the tape on the other tree is still untouched.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that only two trees were marked, the equipment on the ground has been put away, and the other tree's tape has not been removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのままの物も担当と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the tape that remains in place with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二本の状態をそれぞれ伝え、勝手に削らず取扱いを聞いてから片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各木状態別報告と無断削り回避・係員案内後片付けを復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the condition of each tree separately and ask how to handle it before cleaning up, without scraping it on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will report each tree's condition separately, avoid unauthorized scraping, and clean up after staff guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が広場へ伺います。お知らせありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. The person in charge will come to the square. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口の台車を荷物用に借りられると思いました。自分のかばんを載せる前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃台車を旅客荷物用と思い使用前貸出可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I could borrow the cart at the entrance for luggage. I'd like to ask before putting my bag on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought a cleaning cart was for passengers' luggage and ask whether you can borrow it before using it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは清掃作業の台車です。お客様用の貸出品ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is a cart for cleaning work. It isn't available for customers to borrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 誰も押していなかったので使えると思いましたが、まだ触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無人で利用可と推測したが台車未接触と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was available because no one was pushing it, but I haven't touched it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed the unattended cart could be used, but you have not touched it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままにしてください。荷物を運ぶことで困っている点は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please leave it where it is. What difficulty are you having carrying your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かばんを二つ同時に持つと歩きづらいです。台車を勝手にホームへ持っていくのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二鞄同時保持歩行困難で無断台車ホーム移動をやめると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's hard to walk while carrying both bags at once. I won't take the cart to the platform without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that walking while carrying two bags at once is difficult and that you will not take the cart onto the platform without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる支援や移動方法を係員へ確認できます。ご利用の列車を示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can ask staff about available assistance or ways to get around. Can you show us which train you are taking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この列車です。一本ずつ荷物を運んで残りを放置する方法も避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用列車を示し鞄分割運搬で他を放置する案も避けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This train. I'd also like to avoid taking the bags one at a time and leaving the other one unattended.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the train you are taking and say you also want to avoid carrying the bags separately and leaving one unattended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物から離れずに移動できる方法を相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's discuss a way for you to move without leaving your luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 清掃台車を使わず、二つのかばんを持って移動する支援を係員へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作業台車未使用で二鞄保持移動支援照会を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask staff about help moving with both bags, without using the cleaning cart.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will not use the work cart and will ask about help moving with both bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご相談を伝えます。荷物と一緒にこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll pass your request to the person in charge. Please wait here with your luggage.
